FirstWork is building the next generation of agentic AI products for frontline hiring, the work that gets roughly 80% of the world's workforce hired, verified, and paid.

We're looking for a Backend Engineer to design and build the AI-powered product features that carry a worker from application to their first day on the job.

In this role, you'll build and own AI agents running in production: document, browsing, voice, and conversational; collaborating closely with product managers, designers, and the engineers building our AI infrastructure. This is a true product engineering role: you'll own features end to end, ship every week, and see your work meet real enterprise volume the day it merges. Production code, real users, real scale.




THE SCALE WE RUN AT

 - ~50,000 workers a week move through our hiring and onboarding flows.

 - 2.5 million API requests a day across the platform.

 - Millions of document pages a year processed by AI agents, across 40+ countries and a dozen-plus languages.

 - Global staffing, logistics, healthcare, marketplace, and employment platforms across the US, UK, EU, LATAM, and India.

 - Billing on work performed, per document validated and per agent action executed, which makes product design, cost per unit, and gross margin one conversation.
   
   


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Build and ship AI-powered product features using LLMs, document agents, and agentic workflows.

 - Develop backend services and APIs that support model inference, orchestration, and tool execution.

 - Implement document extraction and validation pipelines that read real-world documents and auto-fill product data.

 - Build AI browsing agents that drive government and third-party portals through the browser, where the only interface is the UI.

 - Ship conversational and voice agents that screen and follow up with candidates over phone, SMS, and WhatsApp.

 - Write and debug durable async workflows in Temporal for automations, AI jobs, and bulk actions.

 - Design and evolve the REST APIs and webhooks that customer ATS, HR, and payroll integrations run on.

 - Handle the production realities of AI: prompt design, structured output, retries, evaluation, and cost control.

 - Write clean, maintainable, well-tested code and take part in code and design review.

 - Improve system performance, reliability, and scalability using production data.
   
   


WHAT WE NEED

 - 3–5 years of professional backend engineering experience.

 - Strong Python, with meaningful time in Django and Django REST Framework or a close equivalent.

 - Hands-on experience integrating LLMs or ML-powered features into a live product.

 - Real SQL fluency and sound relational data modelling instincts.

 - Familiarity with APIs, async processing, queues, and distributed systems.

 - Understanding of prompting, structured output, and model inference.

 - Solid fundamentals in testing, debugging, and system design.

 - Care for correctness in multi-tenant systems, where every query stays scoped to a single customer.

 - Clear written communication and a product mindset focused on real-world impact.

 - Experience with agentic systems, workflows, or orchestration frameworks.

 - Browser automation at scale with Playwright or similar.

 - Temporal, Celery, Airflow, or another durable execution engine.

 - PostgreSQL beyond CRUD, and AWS in production.

ABOUT FIRSTWORK

Labour markets are broken. Millions of people are ready to work and can't start. Screening, right-to-work checks, contracts, onboarding and scheduling still run across disconnected systems, with hundreds of manual decisions in between. Firstwork builds AI agents that run frontline workforce operations end to end. We activate hundreds of thousands of workers a month globally for some of the world's largest employers and staffing firms, working forward-deployed inside the customer's operation. Backed by Y Combinator and Gradient (Google’s AI fund), with offices in New York, with London and Dubai opening later this year.




WHY THIS ROLE

European customers are not evaluating us out of curiosity. Workforce compliance has turned into a board-level risk and there are deadlines attached to it. The demand is already here. What we don't have is coverage, or an enterprise motion that repeats.

You are the first commercial hire in Europe and you build the team around you. It is a player-coach role and it stays that way, because we are not going to put someone in charge of coaching a European motion; they have never run against European buyers themselves. You carry a quota while you hire. A Solutions Consultant joins alongside you, SDRs come after that, and how the pod fits together is your call.

None of this starts from zero. The North American playbook holds up on qualification, pricing, security review and technical validation. Your job is to work out which parts of it survive European procurement, works councils and regulators, rebuild the rest, and turn the result into the thing every rep in the region runs.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own enterprise revenue across EMEA, and carry your own deals from first meeting through to signature

 - Build and qualify pipeline in staffing, healthcare, logistics, manufacturing and retail

 - Turn the North American motion into a European playbook other people can run

 - Hire the pod. SDRs, account executives, and with the CEO, the first five people on the team

 - Forecast well enough that the exec team can plan the company against it

 - Get what you hear in the field back to product while it still matters




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Seven or more years selling complex enterprise software, with six and seven figure closes you can talk us through in detail

 - Time selling into staffing, healthcare, logistics, manufacturing and/or retail

 - Deals across more than one European market, so you know how procurement, works councils and regulators change the shape of a cycle

 - Experience hiring and managing reps while still carrying your own number

FirstWork is building the next generation of agentic AI products for frontline hiring, the work that gets roughly 80% of the world's workforce hired, verified, and paid.

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to own a significant part of the platform and ship the AI capability that runs on top of it.

You'll set the standard for the engineers around you and see your work meet live enterprise volume every week.




THE SCALE WE RUN AT

 - ~50,000 workers a week move through our hiring and onboarding flows.

 - 2.5 million API requests a day across the platform.

 - Millions of document pages a year processed by AI agents, across 40+ countries and a dozen-plus languages.

 - Single accounts running hundreds of thousands of AI document extractions in one month, and compliance engines evaluating thousands of customer-specific rules per tenant.

 - Global staffing, logistics, healthcare, marketplace, and employment platforms across the US, UK, EU, LATAM, and India.

 - Billing on work performed, per document validated and per agent action executed, which makes product design, cost per unit, and gross margin one conversation.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own a subsystem end to end document processing, workflow automation, compliance rules, communications, or integrations; and lead the projects inside it from design doc through rollout.

 - Ship AI agent capability into production: extraction and validation pipelines, confidence handling, human review routing, and the feedback loop that raises accuracy document type by document type.

 - Build AI browsing agents that drive government and third-party portals through the browser, where the only interface is the UI.

 - Own accuracy and cost for the AI you ship, across prompts, structured output, evaluation, model selection, and spend per document.

 - Design and evolve the REST APIs and webhooks that customer ATS, HR, and payroll integrations run on.

 - Write durable async workflows in Temporal for automations, AI jobs, and bulk actions, built so that a retry is always safe.

 - Design schema and data models that hold up as tenants, volume, and product surface grow.

 - Improve latency and throughput with production evidence: profile it, fix it, prove the win.

 - Raise the engineering bar around you through design review, code review, and mentoring.

 - Work directly with product and operations to turn a customer's real process into product.




WHAT WE NEED

 - 5+ years of professional backend engineering experience, including a system you owned end to end.

 - Strong SQL and relational data modelling: you design schema before code, and you read query plans when it counts.

 - Solid distributed systems fundamentals across queues, async workers, idempotency, retries, and partial failure.

 - A track record of leading a project across several engineers and landing it.

 - Care for correctness in multi-tenant systems, where every query stays scoped to a single customer.

 - Clear written communication: design docs, pull requests, and incident writeups others can follow.

 - Comfort with ambiguity, and the judgement to define a problem alongside solving it.




NICE TO HAVE

 - Strong Python, with meaningful time in Django and Django REST Framework or a close equivalent.

 - Hands-on experience shipping LLM- or ML-powered features to production.

 - Experience with agentic systems, workflows, or orchestration frameworks.

 - Browser automation at scale with Playwright or similar.

 - Temporal, Celery, Airflow, or another durable execution engine.

 - PostgreSQL beyond CRUD: partial indexes, partitioning, replicas, connection pooling.

 - Regulated domains such as identity, payroll, healthcare, fintech, or compliance.

Our voice and conversational agents screen and follow up with candidates. Our rule engines adjudicate compliance decisions and produce the audit trail behind them.
